summary: Iteration 34 — Retailer-Private Product (off-ecosystem onboarding) capability verified end-to-end. Ran the original 7-test suite + 8-test extended suite (iter34) + regression on test_retailer_offline (19), test_p0_ownership_fix (29) and test_organizations_alias (3). Combined: 60 PASSED, 1 SKIPPED (the in-suite cross-retailer test was replaced with an explicit two-account curl verification using fmn.retailer vs unilever.retailer that all passed). Cross-tenant isolation against another retailer, manufacturer, distributor and wholesaler is fully enforced; super_admin retains visibility by design.
action_items: (Optional) Add a /api/_admin/list-retailers helper so the SKIPPED cross-retailer-discovery test in iter34 suite can run without hard-coding a second email. Currently we proved isolation via an explicit script using fmn.retailer@tradekonekt.io.

(Documentation) Add the new row to the Business Traceability Matrix: 'Retailer onboards off-ecosystem product → invisible upstream' — capability is implemented; only the matrix entry needs to be appended by main agent.
critical_code_review_comments: retailer_products.py (~220 lines) is well-scoped, single-responsibility, no _id leakage (uses {'_id': 0} projections and _public() helper). LGTM.
PATCH endpoint correctly scopes the update by both id AND owner_id, preventing horizontal privilege escalation even if a retailer guesses another retailer's product UUID.
Inventory auto-row uses $setOnInsert with upsert=True — idempotent, will not clobber existing quantities if the row already exists.
Soft-delete uses deleted_at sentinel and the default LIST filter excludes it; include_deleted=true query param works (verified). Good audit hygiene.

Minor: the global /api/products filter in routes/entities.py is the single point of upstream invisibility — recommend adding an explicit assertion in the wholesaler-orders catalogue endpoint as well to defence-in-depth (not blocking; current test proves wholesaler.token never sees retailer-private SKUs).

Explicit cross-retailer evidence (using fmn.retailer vs unilever.retailer) proved: (1) Retailer B's /api/products does NOT include Retailer A's PRIV-* SKU; (2) Retailer B GET/PATCH/DELETE on Retailer A's product → 403; (3) Manufacturer (unilever@), Distributor (mfr-0001-dst-0001@) and Wholesaler (unilever.wholesaler@) /api/products all exclude PRIV-* SKUs; (4) super_admin SEES them by design. Regression: 19/19 offline + 29/29 P0 ownership + 3/3 organizations-alias + 7/7 original private-product = ALL PASS. No new failures introduced.

The one SKIPPED test was due to /api/organizations not surfacing a discoverable second retailer record under Retailer A's token (correct behaviour — A shouldn't enumerate other tenants); the alternative explicit-account verification using fmn.retailer credentials confirmed the same invariant.
